info.name: Sewaam Foundation API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Sewaam Foundation backend.

Base URL: http://localhost:5000

## How to use
1. Import this collection into Postman.
2. Set the `base_url` variable to `http://localhost:5000` (already set as default).
3. Start your server: `npm run dev`
4. Run endpoints in order within each folder — POST first to create test data, then GET/PUT/DELETE.
5. IDs like `{{campaign_id}}` are auto-captured from POST responses via test scripts.

## Notes
- Payment endpoints require valid Razorpay credentials in `.env`.
- Do NOT use real payment data — sample bodies are for structure reference only.
